title: God's Vengeance and Mercy

questions.question: Who is this who comes from Edom, in crimsoned garments from Bozrah, he who is splendid in his apparel, marching in the greatness of his what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 63:1 (ESV): "marching in the greatness of his strength?"

questions.question: "It is I, speaking in righteousness, mighty to what?"
Why is your apparel red, and your garments like his who treads in the what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 63:2 (ESV): "like his who treads in the winepress?"

questions.question: I have trodden the winepress alone, and from the peoples no one was with me; I trod them in my anger and trampled them in my what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 63:3 (ESV): "and trampled them in my wrath;"

questions.question: For the day of vengeance was in my heart, and my year of redemption had what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 63:4 (ESV): "and my year of redemption had come."

questions.question: I looked, but there was no one to help; I was appalled, but there was no one to uphold; so my own arm brought me what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 63:5 (ESV): "so my own arm brought me salvation,"

questions.question: I will recount the steadfast love of the LORD, the praises of the LORD, according to all that the LORD has granted us, and the great goodness to the house of whom?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 63:7 (ESV): "goodness to the house of Israel,"

questions.question: For he said, "Surely they are my people, children who will not deal falsely." And he became their what?
In all their affliction he was afflicted, and the angel of his presence saved them; in his love and in his pity he redeemed them; he lifted them up and carried them all the days of what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 63:9 (ESV): "carried them all the days of old."

questions.question: But they rebelled and grieved his Holy Spirit; therefore he turned to be their enemy, and himself fought against whom?
Then he remembered the days of old, of Moses and his people. Where is he who brought them up out of the sea with the shepherds of his flock? Where is he who put in the midst of them his Holy what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 63:11 (ESV): "put in the midst of them his Holy Spirit,"

questions.question: Who caused his glorious arm to go at the right hand of Moses, who divided the waters before them to make for himself an everlasting what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 63:12 (ESV): "to make for himself an everlasting name,"

questions.question: For you are our Father, though Abraham does not know us, and Israel does not acknowledge us; you, O LORD, are our Father, our Redeemer from of old is your what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 63:16 (ESV): "our Redeemer from of old is your name."

questions.question: O LORD, why do you make us wander from your ways and harden our heart, so that we fear you not? Return for the sake of your servants, the tribes of your what?
We have become like those over whom you have never ruled, like those who are not called by your what?
questions.explanation: Isaiah 63:19 (ESV): "like those who are not called by your name."

key_verse_text: Who is this who comes from Edom, in crimsoned garments from Bozrah, he who is splendid in his apparel, marching in the greatness of his strength? "It is I, speaking in righteousness, mighty to save."
